name: DC Health and Academic Prep Program (DC HAPP)
org: George Washington University School of Medicine and Health Sciences

offerings.summary: A four-week summer programme where DC-area sophomores and juniors practise clinical skills, design a public health project and shadow healthcare professionals at GW Hospital.

loc.venue: GW School of Medicine and Health Sciences, Ross Hall Suite 222

grades.raw: Be currently enrolled as a full-time high school sophomore or junior in a DC/MD/VA school at the time of application

residency.raw: Must be a full-time resident of the DC metro area

school.raw: in a DC/MD/VA school at the time of application

gpa.raw: Have a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.0

other: Demonstrate interest in pursuing a career in medicine or the healthcare field
ability to commit to full four-week program with regular follow-up through high school graduation

deadlines.raw: Students must submit all required application materials by Friday, January 30th, 2026 at 11:59 PM

issues: Exact 2026 programme dates are not published
The 2027 cohort is not yet announced
